calls.video_title: MAJOR BUY! If You Missed Nvidia, This is Even Bigger
calls.thesis: FLIP: last directional stance HOLD (19 Nov; also HOLD 9 Nov). 'I have been buying Okta' with a big position. Identity access and management leader with upwards of 15% market share (CyberArk, bought by Palo Alto, had under 3%). Applying the Zscaler deal terms (11.17x sales, 53x earnings) gives a buyout target of ~$208 per share, only ~7.5% above Monday's price — but he argues a buyer could pay more for the market-leading IAM position.
calls.base: A buyer pays around the $208 Zscaler-terms target.
calls.bull: A bidding war for the IAM leader pays well above $208.
calls.bear: Growth stays slow (~10%) and no buyer steps up at a premium.

calls.thesis: Identity access leader that just beat earnings ($1.05 vs $0.97 expected) with its order backlog up 17% to $4.86B, but only ~10% growth in a slower segment and a single product; too small to stand alone, he keeps waiting for a buyout.
Owns it; covered by the group 'wouldn't be loading up on all of them just yet' - slowest growth in the group at 10-11%.
First tracked Okta call: held in the cybersecurity group, but he probably would not pick up a whole lot more just yet — ~3x PEG, smaller identity-access segment, slowest growth in the group at ~11%.
calls.price_at_call: No price stated; down ~20% over five days, the worst in the group
